package.description: Convert, edit and act on files with radial wheels while you drag them.

en-US.description: Convert, edit and act on files with radial wheels while you drag them.
en-US.longDescription: Lorenz puts three wheels under your cursor while you drag a file - convert it to another format, edit it (compress, resize, rotate, split, merge) or act on it (copy, move, share). Everything runs locally with the engines installed on your computer; originals are never modified.
en-US.name: Lorenz
